review_candidates.description: Fyfe is a multi-disciplinary consultancy providing comprehensive engineering, environmental, planning and surveying services throughout Australia. Fyfe work with a wide range of clients in the Energy & Resources and Property & Infrastructure sectors to provide high quality, commercially pragmatic solutions with a strong focus on client service and delivery. About The Role Our Energy and Resources Division works with major exploration and distribution clients to deliver specialist mining, oil and gas projects across the country. These include process plant modifications, upstream flowlines, leases, network gathering and distribution systems, major gas transmission pipelines, oil and gas above ground processing facilities, as well as maintenance, integrity and construction related work programs. We are recruiting for a Pipeline Engineer to be based in our Philippines team and work remotely to support our team and clients in Australia. The successful candidate will initially be hired by our partner agency in the Philippines as Fyfe builds our presence in the Philippines. This role focuses on the design of buried polyethylene (HDPE / PE100) gas and water gathering networks for Australian coal seam gas and water infrastructure clients. These networks run for tens to hundreds of kilometres of buried pipe across farmland, carrying flammable gas or process water, and connecting wellsite's to processing facilities. You will apply an established engineering design rule set to new network designs, direct our GIS and drafting team on routing, layout and attribution, and escalate the cases the rules do not cover to our Brisbane technical lead. You will not certify designs — that accountability sits with our Registered Professional Engineer of Queensland (RPEQ) in Australia. Skills & Experience We are looking for a qualified engineer with 2 to 5 years' experience designing pipelines, piping or buried pressure networks. Onshore gas experience is ideal, but experience with buried water, LPG or process fluid networks is equally welcome. This is a design role, not a piping stress analysis role. If your primary experience is Caesar II, AutoPIPE or piping stress and flexibility analysis, this position will not suit you, though we would be glad to consider you for other openings. Requirements Tertiary qualifications in Pipeline, Mechanical, Civil, Chemical or Petroleum Engineering Registered Engineer with the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) 2-5 years' experience designing pipelines, piping or buried pressure networks carrying a fluid Experience with either a flammable or hazardous fluid, or a buried pressure network of any fluid. One or the other is sufficient Familiar with GIS. You must be able to read and interrogate spatial data — attribute tables, domains, topology — but you do not need to build it Able to read a hydraulic model output and identify where it disagrees with the drafted alignment Comfortable working Australian core hours (approximately 6am to 3pm Manila time) Strong analytical and technical report writing skills Strong attention to detail High level communication, interpersonal and team management skills Advanced time management, planning and organisational skills Advanced initiative and ability to solve problems Helpful, But Not Required — We Will Teach You These Please do not screen yourself out of this role because you have not worked with the following. We expect to train the right person in all of them. HDPE, PE100 or polyethylene pipe APGA Code of Practice for Upstream Polyethylene Gathering Networks Coal seam gas (CSG) or upstream gathering networks Australian Standards, including AS 2885 and AS/NZS 4130 Previous exposure to Australian projects Hydraulic modelling software A note on career direction This position is deeply technical for at least the first two years. If your ambition over that period is to move into project management or engineering management, this role is unlikely to suit you. If it goes well, you would in time build and lead a small design team in the Philippines, while continuing to do technical work. What We Offer This is an excellent opportunity to progress your career with a growing national engineering consultancy. Fyfe can offer an environment committed to workplace diversity with a team of dedicated and experienced professionals. If you are still not sure, this is why you should apply: Permanent Work from Home arrangement Diverse role, working for a range of clients and learning new skills A chance to learn and share ideas with an offshore colleague Competitive pay and financial support for professional development How to Apply: Please send your CV together with a short note — two paragraphs is plenty — answering the following: Describe a buried pipeline or pressure network you personally worked on. What was the fluid, the pressure, the material, and roughly the length or scale? Have you ever visited a site where a pipeline you worked on was being built, tested or commissioned? Briefly, what did you see? We read the notes before the CVs. If your answers to these two questions are strong, we will read your CV even if your background looks unusual. Culture Fyfe values our clients and our people and has a culture built on respect, integrity and the delivery of value. This is achieved through a combination of flexible and contemporary working conditions supported by an inclusive management style which sees all levels of management being accessible through an open-door policy applicable to everyone. Fyfe have also engaged various corporate entities to offer benefits to staff and encourage an innovative and pro-active approach to projects. With 25+ offices nationally, staff are encouraged to tap into the wealth of knowledge that we have, welcoming information sharing and troubleshooting among colleagues. Benefits Permanent Work from Home: Enjoy the flexibility and convenience of working from the comfort of your own home. Competitive Pay & Professional Development: We offer competitive compensation. Our mentors are here to support and continue your professional development. Government Mandated Benefits: Full compliance with all government-mandated benefits. HMO: Comprehensive health coverage to ensure your well-being. Leave Credits: Generous leave credits to support your work-life balance. Free Learning & Development Courses: Access a wide range of courses designed to enhance both your personal and professional development. Diverse Role: Engage in a variety of responsibilities and projects.
